positive_shifted_finite_band.qualifier: The whole protected band is isolated by a chosen finite penalty; no variance bound is claimed for every narrower energy window.

scope: Full finite L-type Hamiltonian on its invariant defect-free sector, with one finite-penalty isolated-band example; not a bound on every narrower low-energy window, graviton dispersion certificate, physical instrument, gravitational source dictionary or dark-sector identification.

physical_inputs.lattice_and_rule: Gu-Wen L type; cubic periodic box
physical_inputs.energy_unit: J=g=1 only for the reported numerical threshold

claim: Any self-adjoint source that is a function only of all S,V labels is scalar on the code. For any nonzero real a, its best additive-constant operator-norm approximation to a*H has error at least abs(a)*sqrt(variance).
